### Type of change

- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Methodology
- [ ] Localization
- [ ] Landing page UI
- [ ] Tests or tooling

### Checks

- [ ] I updated English and Russian text where relevant.
- [ ] I ran `npm run test:i18n`, or explained why it was not run.
- [ ] I ran `npm test` when the full local test suite was relevant.
- [ ] I checked new local Markdown links and image paths.
- [ ] I updated third-party notices for new screenshots, logos, datasets or libraries.
